title: Cancer: what to know
description: The essentials of Cancer in a few screens: strengths, challenges, love and work.

pages.title: Cancer: the basics
pages.text: Approximate dates: Jun 21 - Jul 22. Water element, cardinal quality, ruled by the Moon.

pages.title: Care
pages.text: Cancer senses what others feel and creates a safe place for the people they love.

pages.title: Sensitivity
pages.text: Can take things personally and withdraw. Saying how they feel avoids stored-up hurt.

pages.title: Affection and protection
pages.text: Wants a bond, everyday tenderness and loyalty. Opens up little by little.

pages.title: The one who welcomes
pages.text: Looks after teams and clients and remembers details others forget.
